headline: Posts and stories keep your current audience warm.
subheadline: Reels bring the new ones in.
caption:
People think it's all about going viral. It's not.

Reels bring new people to the page. Posts and stories keep the people who already found you warm, engaged, and ready to buy.

You need both — discovery and retention.

headline: "The consumer isn't a moron. She is your wife."
caption:
"The consumer isn't a moron; she is your wife." — David Ogilvy

The father of advertising said it decades ago and it's never been more true. Don't talk down to your audience. Don't use empty hype. Respect their intelligence and they'll reward you with attention.

Good content treats people like they're smart.

Follow @josephborroto for marketing principles that still hold up.

headline: "If it doesn't sell, it isn't creative."
caption:
"If it doesn't sell, it isn't creative." — David Ogilvy

Pretty edits and clever ideas mean nothing if they don't move someone to act. Creativity in marketing has a job: results.

Make content that's beautiful AND that works.

Follow @josephborroto for the difference between art and marketing.

headline: "Macro patience, micro speed."
caption:
"Macro patience, micro speed." — Gary Vaynerchuk

Move fast on the small stuff — post today, ship the video, hit publish. Be endlessly patient on the big stuff — the audience, the brand, the payoff.

Most people do the opposite: slow to post, impatient for results.

Follow @josephborroto for the long game on content.

headline: Make an offer so good people feel stupid saying no.
caption:
Alex Hormozi built his whole framework on one idea: make offers so good people feel stupid saying no.

The same applies to content. Make the value so obvious, so useful, so worth-the-watch that scrolling past feels like a mistake.

Over-deliver in the first 5 seconds.

Follow @josephborroto for content that's impossible to scroll past.

headline: What MrBeast obsesses over (and you should too).
bullets: Click-through first: if no one taps, nothing else matters
Then watch time: deliver on the promise fast
Re-do your first 5 seconds until they're perfect
footer_note: Same rules apply to your Reels.
caption:
MrBeast's content philosophy, boiled down — and it maps perfectly to short-form:

1. Obsess over the click (thumbnail/hook). If no one taps, nothing else matters.
2. Then obsess over watch time — deliver on the promise immediately.
3. Re-write your first 5 seconds until they communicate everything.

The biggest creator on earth sweats the open. So should you.

Follow @josephborroto for lessons from the best.

#mrbeast #youtube #shortformvideo #retention #contentstrategy #josephborroto
